applicable_failures: Filename prefilter: the main scan only opened .docx files whose names matched merger/purchase-agreement/apa/acquisition/agreement-execution, so matters with other filenames were never read. The agent's own summary admits 'non-obvious filenames' still need checking.
Scan timed out: the final broad all-.docx scan hit 'timed out after 60s' and was not rerun. Coverage is partial, and the sub-threshold conclusion rests on that partial output.

The 1045 series (1045-00004 to 00007) was named as the focus of this stage but is still listed as having no document opened. The agent's claimed Cascadia (1022-00006) and Verimark (1021-00001) findings are also not backed by any opened document in the shown output.
Output was capped with head -80 after a grep for dollar amounts, so the visible candidate set came from a filtered view. The first scan also failed with a SyntaxError before the rerun.
critique.concerns: The stage did not verify its candidates. The 1045 series was never opened and about 32 matters remain unread. The only shown output is a $55m tax-credit purchase and a tax opinion, neither of which is a large deal. The self-assessment of goal_reached=True is not supported, and the claim that no $1bn+ deal exists is unproven.
critique.recommendation: Rerun the scan in smaller batches, by matter folder, without filename filters, so it doesn't time out. Print per-matter amounts and governing-law snippets with a modest cap per matter. Then open the executed agreements in the 1045 series and the other unopened matters, and record base consideration separately from earnout or CVR value, with the governing-law clause.
